title: Exact locally closed coefficient extension through the scheme-theoretic closure
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme (locally Noetherian and quasi-compact), let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring, and use internal modules over $\Lambda_Y=p_Y^*\Lambda$ on each small pro-étale site $Y_{\mathrm{proét}}$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Every open, closed, or locally closed subscheme of $X$ is Noetherian; its underlying space is topologically Noetherian, all its open immersions are quasi-compact, and it is quasi-separated. Let $a:S\hookrightarrow X$ be a locally closed immersion, meaning a closed immersion into an open subscheme of $X$. It is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Its scheme-theoretic image $\overline S=\operatorname{SIm}(a)$ [def-nagata-scheme-theoretic-closure] has underlying set $\overline{a(S)}$, and the canonical factorization $S\xrightarrow{u}\overline S\xrightarrow{i}X$ [def-nagata-scheme-image-factor] has $u$ open and $i$ closed. For the actual coefficient-module functors [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek, def-sfb-module-lower-star], both $u_!$ and $i_*$ are exact, and hence so is the locally closed coefficient extension $a_!=i_*u_!$ of [def-sfb-locally-closed-coefficient-extension]. For every cochain complex $K$ of $\Lambda_S$-modules there are natural isomorphisms $H^n(a_!K)\cong a_!H^n(K)$ for every integer $n$. The termwise functor preserves quasi-isomorphisms and induces a functor $D(S_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda_S)\to D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda_X)$ with a natural isomorphism $Q_S\,D(a_!)\cong C(a_!)\,Q_X$, where $C(a_!)$ denotes termwise application and $Q$ denotes localization at quasi-isomorphisms [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Empty schemes and zero complexes are allowed.

proof.text: For an immersion b:T→X, its topological embedding induces NoetherianSpace T from NoetherianSpace X [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-scheme-closed-subsets-minimal]. Every subset of T is compact [lem-sfb-noetherian-space-compact-subsets]. An immersion is locally of finite type (Mathlib IsImmersion.instLocallyOfFiniteType, the packaged closed/open finite-type argument of [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-proper] and [def-weil-open-immersion]). Apply LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian from [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] and combine with compactness to construct IsNoetherian T. Its quasi-separatedness is [lem-weil-pbc-locally-noetherian-quasi-separated]. Every open immersion into T has Noetherian source by its embedding, so is quasi-compact. The proof hsource makes all these constructions uniformly for T and b.

Apply the first step to S. Compactness of all subsets makes a quasi-compact. It is quasi-separated because an immersion is a monomorphism, whose diagonal is an isomorphism [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. The canonical a.toImage is open by [lemma-nagata-immersion-open-in-scheme-image]. The image inclusion is closed and a.toImage ≫ a.imageι = a by [def-nagata-scheme-theoretic-image, def-nagata-scheme-image-factor]. Rewrite its range using IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι and Hom.support_ker: range(a.imageι)=a.ker.support=closure(range(a)), the scheme-theoretic closure of [def-nagata-scheme-theoretic-closure].

Form the complementary open V with carrier complement(range(a.imageι)); its inclusion V.ι is quasi-compact by Noetherianity. Apply the already proved CondensedRing.closedSupport_lowerStarExact from [det-lem-formal-closed-support-adjunction] with i=a.imageι and j=V.ι. The complement equality is converted to its required orientation by double complementation. This theorem applies directly to the actual internal coefficient functor CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ i of [def-sfb-module-lower-star]. Its proof exhibits this functor as a left adjoint to closed support, so finite-colimit preservation follows without a sectionwise-module comparison. Left exactness and additivity are the existing lowerStar instances. This uses the closed-support adjunction solely as a generic exactness tool, preserving the coefficient-heart unit route through the canonical closure and the exact open/closed factors.

The actual open factor is additive and preserves finite limits and colimits by [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek]. Unfold [def-sfb-locally-closed-coefficient-extension]: the defined functor is exactly openImmersionLowerShriek Λ a.toImage followed by lowerStar Λ a.imageι. The existing composition instances supply finite-limit preservation, finite-colimit preservation and additivity of this exact composite. No object is selected from an existence assertion.

For F=coefficientHeartLocallyClosedExtension Λ a ha, apply ShortComplex.homologyFunctorIso, whiskered by HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor in each integer degree [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-complex-cohomology]. This is definitionally the required natural isomorphism on cochain complexes. Functor.preservesHomologyOfExact and HomologicalComplex.quasiIso_map_of_preservesHomology give quasi-isomorphism preservation. Finally take D=F.mapDerivedCategory and F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors from [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. This gives precisely Q⋙D ≅ C(F)⋙Q. All results are unbounded and require no nonemptiness hypothesis, so empty schemes, zero rings and zero complexes are included.

Status: still unsplit live, no repair note on the item, not superseded. The statement is unchanged; stmt_deps dropped the unused sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback and added the geometric definitions the statement uses. No new nodes, no cycle (its closure of 694 nodes does not reach the item), no SGA citation. Step 1: open subschemes of X are Noetherian, and closed subschemes of those are finite type over them, hence Noetherian. Descending chains of closed subsets give that every subset is quasi-compact, so every open immersion into them is quasi-compact; quasi-separated by the locally-Noetherian lemma. Step 2: a and its diagonal are quasi-compact, so the immersion-open-in-image leaf applies; i is closed and i∘u = a. Closed and dense means the underlying set is the closure of a(S). This is the same toImage/imageι factorization fixed by def-sfb-locally-closed-coefficient-extension. Step 3: the hypotheses of the internal/sectionwise module equivalence are met, the module categories are abelian, and alpha_f is a ring isomorphism for any condensed ring. The passage from alpha_i to a ring-sheaf identification is written briefly but is routine. Step 4: lem-sfb-proetale-identified-open-closed applies because the complementary open is quasi-compact (retrocompact, as 09BM needs). Its action through the adjoint of c equals the eta_i action of def-sfb-module-lower-star. I accept it as the declared tool use. Steps 5-7: u_! is exact by its definition node, so the composite i_*u_! is exact. The exact-functor leaves give the cohomology isomorphisms for all n with no bounds, and Q_S D(a_!) ≅ C(a_!) Q_X written in diagrammatic order. Edge cases checked: empty S, closed or open a, nonreduced scheme-theoretic closure, zero ring, unbounded complexes. Neighbouring nodes (locally-closed-extension-coherence, the module-extension-coherence node, the existential proetale-locally-closed-extension, immersion-limit-preservation) work with ring sheaves R, a different factorization or a pullback, so none duplicates this item.

lean.statement: theorem coefficientHeart_locallyClosedExtension (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] : (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (b : T ⟶ X), IsImmersion b → IsNoetherian T ∧ TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace T ∧ QuasiSeparatedSpace T ∧ ∀ (V : Scheme.{u}) (j : V ⟶ T), IsOpenImmersion j → QuasiCompact j) ∧ ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (a : S ⟶ X) (ha : IsImmersion a), QuasiCompact a ∧ QuasiSeparated a ∧ Set.range a.imageι = closure (Set.range a) ∧ a.toImage ≫ a.imageι = a ∧ IsClosedImmersion a.imageι ∧ Exists fun [_hu : IsOpenImmersion a.toImage] ↦ PreservesFiniteLimits (CondensedRing.openImmersionLowerShriek Λ a.toImage) ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits (CondensedRing.openImmersionLowerShriek Λ a.toImage) ∧ PreservesFiniteLimits (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ a.imageι) ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ a.imageι) ∧ PreservesFiniteLimits (coefficientHeartLocallyClosedExtension Λ a ha) ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits (coefficientHeartLocallyClosedExtension Λ a ha) ∧ Exists fun [_hadd : (coefficientHeartLocallyClosedExtension Λ a ha).Additive] ↦ (∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty ((coefficientHeartLocallyClosedExtension Λ a ha).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor _ (.up ℤ) n ≅ HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor _ (.up ℤ) n ⋙ coefficientHeartLocallyClosedExtension Λ a ha)) ∧ (∀ (K L : CochainComplex (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ S)) ℤ) (f : K ⟶ L), QuasiIso f → QuasiIso (((coefficientHeartLocallyClosedExtension Λ a ha).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map f)) ∧ ∃ D : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ S)) ⥤ DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X)), Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ D ≅ (coefficientHeartLocallyClosedExtension Λ a ha).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
